annotations.title: Raise sede to thy brother.
annotations.text: <mn>[1]</mn> By this it appeareth, that in the law of nature, when a maried man died without issue, his brother might lawfully marie the widow: whose first sonne should be counted and called the sonne and heyre of his vncle dead before. The same was established by the law of Moyses (Deut. 25) VVhich being now abrogated, it remaineth in the Churches powre to constitute a law in this behalf, <mn>[2]</mn>and consequently to dispense in the same, so farre as is agreable with the law of nature. VVherof see more. Leuit. 18.

notes.text: How a man might marie his brothers wife in the law of nature. The Churches decree is now our rule.
The Church's decree is now our rule.
